title: Learning from other bands and encouraging weaker players
summary: Angrum says he got good by playing in many good bands, picking up ideas and practising them at home. He says feeling matters more than a teacher, and that you should encourage and cover for weaker players. He then lists the bands he played with.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
